import sys, random, ctypes
sys.path.insert(0,'.'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
import numpy as np
from netnomos.finite import prefix_match_mask, prefix_tokens

rng = random.Random(7)
# boundary + random values across the whole legal range
vals = sorted(set([0,1,9,10,11,99,100,101,999,1000,1001,9999,10000,10001,99999,100000,100001,
                   999999,1000000,5,55,555,5555,55555,555555,123456,654321,100000,200000]
                  + [rng.randrange(0,1000001) for _ in range(4000)]))
arr = np.array(vals, dtype=np.int64)
prefixes = ['', '0', '1', '9', '00', '01', '010', '10', '100', '1000', '10000', '100000', '1000000',
            '10000000', '999999', '9999999', '2', '20', '205', '1234567', '0000000', '5', '55',
            '5555555', '123456', '6543210', '7', '0000001']
bad = 0
for p in prefixes:
    got = prefix_match_mask(arr, p)
    want = np.array([str(v).startswith(p) for v in vals], dtype=bool)
    if not np.array_equal(got, want):
        bad += 1
        print('PREFIX MISMATCH', repr(p), [v for v,g,w in zip(vals,got,want) if g!=w][:10])
    # tokens vs brute force
    gtok = prefix_tokens(arr, p)
    chars=set(); end=False
    for v in vals:
        s=str(v)
        if s.startswith(p):
            if s==p: end=True
            else: chars.add(s[len(p)])
    wtok=[d for d in '0123456789' if d in chars]+(['END'] if end else [])
    if gtok!=wtok:
        bad+=1; print('TOKEN MISMATCH', repr(p), gtok, wtok)
print('prefix matcher mismatches:', bad, 'values:', len(vals))
# exhaustive small range
arr2 = np.arange(0, 20000, dtype=np.int64)
for p in prefixes:
    got = prefix_match_mask(arr2, p)
    want = np.array([str(v).startswith(p) for v in range(20000)], dtype=bool)
    assert np.array_equal(got,want), p
print('exhaustive 0..19999 ok')
EOF
